bioconda.name: rfam-seed-qc
bioconda.summary: Validate and fix Stockholm seed alignments for Rfam.
bioconda.description:
rfam-seed-qc checks Stockholm multiple sequence alignments (Rfam seed
alignments) for format errors and, with --fix, corrects common problems:
missing coordinates, duplicate and overlapping sequences, and sequences
that do not match their NCBI or RNAcentral source, with a BLAST fallback
(NCBI web BLAST, or a local database with --local). Optional checks
against known Rfam families use Infernal's cmscan.

commands: for t in cmscan cmpress esl-reformat blastn blastdbcmd wget; do command -v "$t"; done

printf '# STOCKHOLM 1.0

X01/1-4 ACGU
X02/1-4 ACGU
#=GC SS_cons <..>
//
' > ok.sto
if rfam-seed-qc bad.sto > bad.log 2>&1; then exit 1; fi
